correctness.rationale: For all real r>=0 in X={0,1,2,3}^3 with inclusive Hamming threshold, scale r<1 is 64 points; 1<=r<2 collapses 48 coordinate-line tetrahedra to a connected graph of 64 vertices and 144 edges, hence wedge^81 circles. At 2<=r<3, adjacency iff words agree in at least one coordinate, so VR is exactly Ind(K4 categorical product K4 categorical product K4). Independently enumerated all maximal cliques, obtaining precisely 508 facets equal to 12 coordinate planes, 64 radius-one Hamming balls and 432 parity tetrahedra. Their union enumerates exactly 830101 augmented faces; independent greedy matching has 414848 pairs and 405 unmatched tetrahedra. Topological sorting all 6539456 incidences checks acyclicity, yielding a CW model with one 0-cell and 405 3-cells, hence wedge^405 S3 integrally. r>=3 yields the full simplex. Persistence interval descriptions follow from these disjoint-degree stages. This proves finite (4,4,4), not general q.
